title: Uniqueness of normalized completed Chern adjuncts
statement:
theorem completedChernNormalized_unique
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S]
    {f : X ⟶ S}
    (p : DiagonalTrace.Presentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f)
    (a a' : DiagonalTrace.completedUnit l S ⟶
      p.Rc.R.obj ((DiagonalTrace.completedLine l X) ⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (ha : CompletedChernNormalized l p a)
    (ha' : CompletedChernNormalized l p a') : a = a'

source.place: Normalization uniqueness for the completed Chern adjunct in the none-coefficient exchange.

proof.text: Cancel the invertible presentation source comparison in the two normalization equations, then use faithfulness of completed scalar restriction on this completed hom set to recover equality of the original adjuncts.
